title: fix(spec): os migrate meta --stored lists a stored dashboard whose global filter reuses the reserved dateRange key

_Requested by **Yibo Wang** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwB?thread=cmsg_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwBY61hHdLdFdzwXbxaNtv58y)_
Fixes #29541
Supersedes #29586 (same commits, resumed on a new branch, merged with main after #29589; #29586 is closed)

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：`os migrate meta --stored` 现在会列出「看板声明了内置 `dateRange`，又有一个全局筛选器也叫 `dateRange`」的已存数据行；两条看板筛选器迁移条目的验收句都补上了「存量预览会列出这种行」。
- 为什么改：#29213 已让每道门拒收这种看板，但升级前的存量预览不报它，运维升级前看不到哪些看板下次保存会被拒。
- 风险与回滚：只读检测，任何入口的接受/拒收结果都不变，不改写任何行；回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看：`packages/spec/src/conversions/refused-shapes.ts` 的 `dashboardReservedDateRangeGlobalFilter`（调用拒收门同一个判定函数，与 #29589 的 `objectExtensionFieldPatchKeyGrammar` 并存），再看 `refused-shapes.test.ts` 末尾 #29541 五条。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec exec vitest run src/conversions/refused-shapes.test.ts`，预期 92 个测试全过（含 #29554 的四条），其中 #29541 五条。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

- **Stored listing.** `REFUSED_STORED_SHAPES` gains `dashboardReservedDateRangeGlobalFilter` (id `ui-dashboard-global-filter-reserved-date-range-refused`, the #29213 D3 entry of step 18), registered right after `dashboardDuplicateGlobalFilterName`. It walks `stack.dashboards[]` and calls `reservedDateRangeGlobalFilters(dashboard.dateRange, dashboard.globalFilters)` from `ui/duplicate-global-filter-names.ts`, the predicate `DashboardSchema`'s refinement reads; no logic is copied. One TODO per entry, at `dashboards[i].globalFilters[j].name` (or `.field` when the entry has no `name`), which is the site the parse refuses. `from` carries the reserved key and the index only. The reason leads with the fate (no lossless rewrite, loads with `_diagnostics.valid: false`, next save refused 422) and ends with the predicate's own message.
- **Upgrade guide entries.** `acceptanceCriteria` of `18.ui-dashboard-global-filter-reserved-date-range-refused.ts` and of `18.ui-dashboard-global-filter-duplicate-name-refused.ts` (#29023) each gain one sentence: `os migrate meta --stored` lists each such stored dashboard under the entry's id, at the site the parse refuses.
- **Docblock.** The `refused-shapes.ts` header's list of borrowed predicates names `reservedDateRangeGlobalFilters`.
- **Changeset.** `.changeset/29541-reserved-date-range-stored-detector.md`, `@objectstack/spec` patch.

## Why

The refusal's D3 entry already promised that a stored row with the pair loads as invalid and is refused on its next save, but the stored preview read such a row as already on protocol. An operator previewing the upgrade saw nothing.

## Tests

`refused-shapes.test.ts` gains five cases under `#29541`, and the roster pin names the new id:

- the card shape (a declared `dateRange` beside an entry named `dateRange`): one TODO at `dashboards[0].globalFilters[0].name` with the reserved word, the built-in date range and the predicate's message; the row is not rewritten, and the parse still refuses the same site;
- an entry with no `name` and `field: 'dateRange'`: listed once at `.field`, as the parse locates it;
- two entries both named `dateRange`: listed under each refusal (one duplicate-key TODO and two reserved-key TODOs), exactly the three `custom` issues the parse raises;
- CONTROL: with no `dateRange` declared, an entry keyed `dateRange` (by name or by field) is not listed and the parse accepts it;
- CONTROL: beside a declared `dateRange`, a named entry whose `field` is `dateRange` is not listed and parses.

Ablation (fix committed first; `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs --delete` on the registry line `  dashboardReservedDateRangeGlobalFilter,`): Tests 4 failed | 84 passed (88). The roster pin and the three listing cases went red, both controls stayed green. Restored: blob after restore equals HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty. The spec suite imports `./refused-shapes.js` from source, so no dist was involved.

## Acceptance notes

- Premise measured on `origin/main` @ `ff827bcf` before the change: `applyConversionsToStoredItem('dashboard', row, { onTodo })` for a declared `dateRange` beside an entry named `dateRange` gave 0 TODOs while the parse refused `globalFilters.0.name`. The control, two filters named `r`, gave 1 (`ui-dashboard-global-filter-duplicate-name-refused`).
- `duplicate-global-filter-names.ts` and `dashboard.zod.ts` are untouched. No ledger moved. The detector adds no new export, so `api-surface` did not change.
- No save-door pin is added in `packages/metadata-protocol`. The sibling's PR added one; this order's file surface names none, and #29370's spec test covers the refusal in each door's form.
- Serial: #29554's PR #29589 (`57958aab`) edited the same `refused-shapes.ts` and merged first. The merge of `origin/main` @ `3d5933a9` conflicted in `refused-shapes.ts` and its test and was resolved additively: #29589's `refusedFieldPatchKeys` / `objectExtensionFieldPatchKeyGrammar` (and its `ObjectExtensionSchema` import) stay, this card's dashboard detector stays, the header docblock names both borrowed predicates, and `REFUSED_STORED_SHAPES` lists `dashboardReservedDateRangeGlobalFilter` then `objectExtensionFieldPatchKeyGrammar`. The roster pin counts both new ids. No generated path moved on either side, so `os-regen-merge.sh` had nothing to take.
